Lillie Mae Morgan Mosley

She married Wilbur MOSLEY who was born 1 September, 1882 and died 28 May, 1966. Wilbur was also a part of the mixed blood Cheswold community. Both are buried at the Fork Branch cemetary in Cheswold.
